work.description: Letter LXIX (printed EPISTOLA ENCYCLICA, ad perpetuam rei memoriam) condemns the works of Georg Hermes and orders their entry in the Index; LF12560 → LF12569 across own provenance LF12563 and page-86 running title LF12566; LF12698 re- → LF12704 probamus across an outer-margin mark LF12701; complete 26 September 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF12487–12487; the source closing at LF12734–12737 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima sexta septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
